name: JTBD2 — Slowest extract refreshes via Admin Insights
description: Admin read path. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model should use query-admin-insights (kind=job-performance) filtered to RefreshExtracts, aggregating on the duration field to rank the slowest extract refreshes. Traps: the duration field caption is 'Job Execution Duration' (NOT 'Avg Duration Job'); queue time is 'Job Queued Duration'; the 'limit' argument is TOP-LEVEL, not inside the query object (it is rejected as an unrecognized key inside query). Read-only.
prompt: Which extract refreshes are the slowest on this site? Use the Admin Insights Job Performance view, filtered to extract-refresh jobs, and rank by execution duration. Report the slowest task and the field(s) you aggregated on. Do not modify anything.
